criteria.text: Existing homepage Status panel renders a responsive Sony widget for every and only connected discovered Sony camera, below existing home controls.
Each widget has independent model/id/transport/status, preview, six dropdowns using exact live property names, errors, and touch state; two fake connected cameras demonstrate independent behavior.
Device Config contains discovery/explicit connect controls; dashboard does not contain connect/reconnect operations.
Browser uses only /api/sony/*; SONY_API_URL stays server-side and defaults to 127.0.0.1:8181.

Narrow proxy validates MAC-like IDs, exact live six-property allowlist, property value input, and normalized touch coordinates; upstream uses literal colon IDs; requests have timeouts; camera IDs inserted into HTML attributes are escaped.
Sequential per-widget preview polling has no overlap, about 8fps max, pauses while hidden, and uses bounded retry/backoff while preserving stale last frame.
Six dropdowns are camera-populated, unavailable/non-writable controls cannot submit, and failed saves visibly restore confirmed values.
Preview click/tap maps only actual contained-image pixels to [0,1], ignores padding, and offers visible point feedback.
Keyboard-accessible X/Y plus Apply fallback, labels, preview alt text, and aria-live statuses exist; copy explains Touch Function controls focus vs tracking.
Existing status/config/controller/activity behavior remains intact; no controller/MotionDevice/ATEM/YAML/dependency changes.
pnpm build, pnpm test:smoke, and git diff --check pass. Smoke coverage must include fake Sony upstream for multi-camera filtering/proxy validation and HTML/JS presence.
Physical multi-camera Sony dashboard behavior is verified with real cameras.

criteria.text: Reconcile connected widgets by camera ID without wholesale root replacement; preserve existing controls/preview, prevent overlapping property loads and duplicate polling, and cleanly remove inactive widgets and object URLs.
Sony grid, widget, and controls fit below 320px at mobile/200% zoom using a targeted one-column overflow guard.
Preview has a deliberate accessible initial loading state and announces stale, recovered, and non-OK live-view-start failure while retaining a visible stale marker.
Discovery failure clears stale cameras before Device Config render; non-OK connect rejects and shows an accessible Device Config status.
Sony widget selects, number inputs, and Apply button have at least 44px interactive height, scoped only to Sony controls.
Each Sony widget is an article with an actual heading labeling both the article and preview region.
Smoke coverage guards reconciliation, narrow layout, accessible preview/connect errors, 44px targets, and all prior exact Sony behavior.

Track preview announcement state per camera and announce only meaningful transitions: initial loading state has an accessible status, loading -> ready once, ready -> stale once, stale -> recovered once. Repeated good frames and repeated failures must not update aria-live.

After explicit discovery or connect, cache Sony identities; repeated dashboard lists use per-camera connection GET checks, preserve the cache on a discovery failure, normalize nested camera/data responses, and allow 30 seconds for connect while property and touch requests remain short.

At desktop widths, four connected Sony widgets fit in four equal columns with a 16:9 preview and compact two-column settings; tablet uses two columns and mobile one, without hiding controls or weakening accessibility.
